The '''"Escort Speeder"''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] built by [[Dromor Motors]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This vehicle was used to escort important dignitaries.<ref name="ML" />
